description: This file defines a custom exception class NotImplementedException used within the OrangeHRM installer implementation. It extends the base Exception class and provides a default error message for cases where a feature or method is not implemented.

classes.name: NotImplementedException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate that a certain feature or method has not been implemented.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the exception with a default message or a provided message, along with optional code and previous exception.
